body.description: The whole request message as proto3 JSON (path and query parameters are fields of it); absent or null is an empty message. Unknown fields are refused.

id.description: The client's handle for the call, unique among its calls in flight; free again after the call's `end` or `error`.

method.description: The RPC's full name, `iohr.events.v1.EventsService/StreamEvents`: the operation's `x-iohr-rpc` in /openapi.json.

Cancel.description: Stop a call in flight. It ends with `end`, like any other.

id.description: The client's handle for the call, unique among its calls in flight; free again after the call's `end` or `error`.

Data.description: One response message: the same JSON the REST route answers, or one event of its stream.

id.description: The client's handle for the call, unique among its calls in flight; free again after the call's `end` or `error`.

End.description: The call is over and its id is free again.

id.description: The client's handle for the call, unique among its calls in flight; free again after the call's `end` or `error`.

Error.description: The call failed, or a frame did not make sense; the keys are the REST error envelope's. Without `id` it concerns the socket: one sent as the server ends the socket (a revoked key: `unauthenticated`; the longest life: `unavailable`) precedes the close.

code.description: The error code; a client keeps a code it does not know.

details.description: Typed details, the REST envelope's `details` (`Problem` in /openapi.json).

description: The multiplexed socket at /v1/ws: every public RPC over one WebSocket, many calls at once told apart by the client's id. Text frames, one JSON object each. A client sends `call` and `cancel`; the server answers each call with `data` frames (one for a unary RPC, one per message for a stream) and exactly one `end` or `error`. A key or scoped token calls what its scopes admit, the same routes as on REST; anything else is an `error` frame with code `forbidden`. The identity is fixed at the upgrade.
title: The /v1/ws frames
